NOTE
**Still not ready — fixture was hand-built, not captured from Jira**

New: The description now says "Part of #16189", explains how the fixture was made, and includes a dev-environment screenshot. There was no new push. Missing: the fixture was "constructed" from Atlassian's spec and existing fixtures, not captured from a real Jira instance, which the fixture guidelines require.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and have the author replace the fixture with a real captured payload (Niloth-p has already rejected constructed fixtures on the related Jira PR #39998).

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the updates, @huriazahra. The fixture still needs to be a payload captured from a real Jira instance (for example via webhook.site) rather than one built from the API spec; see the [fixture guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/webhooks/incoming-webhooks-walkthrough.html#fixture-guidelines). Please replace it with a captured one and update the test and screenshot to match.
```
